svg.title: Sheet 3 - Verifier Proteus version
svg.text: SHEET 3 OF 3 - EXTERNAL VERIFIER, PROTEUS VERSION (Arduino Mega stand-in for ESP32 + ATM90E26)
MAINS TIE-IN: insert ACS2 in series after ACS1
Cut the wire ACS1 IP- -> lamp bus, then wire ACS1 IP- -> ACS2 IP+ and ACS2 IP- -> lamp bus.
LINK FROM METER AND SERIAL LOG
Direct wire (both boards 5 V). Join the GND of both Megas.
1. U3 is a second Mega with its OWN sensors:
it measures the load independently of the meter U1.
2. TR2 = TR1 settings (400 H / 1 H, k 0.999). ACS2 is in
series with ACS1 so both see the same current.
3. LIVE, NEUTRAL, GND are shared with Sheet 1.
The R7 reference on Sheet 1 also covers this sheet.
4. FROM_METER = wire from Sheet 1 U1 D18 (TX1) to U3 D19.
6. Type L0 / L1 / R<n> in VT2 to label the experiment.
7. LEDs: green NORMAL, yellow SUSPECT, red ALERT.
8. Stand-in for ESP32 + ATM90E26 (no Proteus models).
Values from calculation; verify in simulation.
